reason: I already pay for Cursor/Copilot and I'm reluctant to bolt another local daemon onto my workflow. As one person, cross-agent context sharing isn't a pain I feel daily, so a launch-day pre-sale from a founder I don't know won't make me add a tool.
objection: It's another subscription and another piece of local infrastructure to maintain when Cursor and Copilot already work, and I don't know this founder or tool enough to trust it on my machine.
would_change_my_mind: A peer engineering lead I trust uses it for a month and shows me a real cross-agent handoff that saved them hours.
